categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in special functional materials including stealth materials, camouflage materials, and protective materials for major national defense equipment such as aircraft, main battle tanks, ships, and missiles. It also extends into aerospace engine parts processing and manufacturing, ceramic matrix composites for aero engines, and acoustic metamaterials. Subsidiaries focus on aerospace engine parts manufacturing, acoustic materials and equipment, ceramic composite materials R&D and production, and specialized testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-temperature resistant stealth coatings, structural stealth composite materials, multi-spectrum compatible camouflage materials, high-efficiency thermal barrier coatings, heavy-duty anti-corrosion materials, electromagnetic shielding materials, acoustic metamaterials, and ceramic matrix composite materials. Production methods involve customized coating processes, composite material fabrication, precision machining of aerospace engine parts, and laser ultrasonic non-destructive testing. The company emphasizes R&D collaboration with universities and research institutes, utilizing supercomputing for material design and simulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are military organizations, defense research institutes, and military enterprises, particularly those under major military industrial groups. The products serve key defense sectors including aviation, aerospace, naval, and ground military equipment. The company also targets civil markets such as industrial noise reduction, power energy, rail transit, petrochemical, shipbuilding, and construction industries for its protective and acoustic materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and subsidiaries in key industrial regions including Shanghai, Nanjing, Shenyang, and Guiyang. Its market coverage is predominantly domestic, serving national defense and industrial sectors across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the R&D, production, and processing of specialized materials and components. It acts as a core supplier to military equipment manufacturers and provides value-added coating and manufacturing services on customer-provided parts. It also engages in technical services and product maintenance, positioning itself as an integrated materials and components supplier within the defense industrial chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing multi-spectrum compatible stealth materials, high-temperature resistant coatings, structural stealth composites, and ceramic matrix composites for aerospace engines. The company invests heavily in R&D, collaborating with top universities and research institutes to innovate in acoustic metamaterials and laser ultrasonic testing technologies. It pursues a product development strategy of 'equipment generation, pre-research generation, and exploratory generation' to maintain technological leadership and expand product lines. Future R&D focuses on ultra-high temperature materials, multifunctional materials, lightweight composites, and intelligent materials with sensing and adaptive capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of specialized functional materials and components, customized manufacturing services, and technical service contracts. The company operates primarily on a make-to-order basis, with sales contracts often linked to military equipment development programs. Revenue recognition includes product sales upon delivery and acceptance, and technical service income upon project completion and client approval. Pricing for military products involves provisional pricing with subsequent adjustments upon government approval.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few domestic enterprises capable of comprehensive design, R&D, and production of stealth materials across temperature ranges, holding a leading position in mid-to-high temperature stealth materials. It has established strong market barriers through early industrialization and extensive product certification. The company is a core supplier within the Chinese aerospace engine industry and integrates deeply with major military industrial groups, enhancing its competitive position. It faces competition from both domestic and international advanced materials suppliers but leverages its technological innovation and government-backed projects for market advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 917.45 million, a 36.45% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 335 million, a slight increase of 0.48%. Total assets grew by 22.33% to RMB 5.16 billion, reflecting expansion through investment projects and subsidiary development. R&D expenditure increased by 18.64% to RMB 73.5 million, representing 8.01% of revenue. The company maintains a strong cash position with over RMB 1 billion in cash and equivalents and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technological capabilities in stealth, camouflage, and protective materials, particularly its unique ability to cover a full temperature range for stealth coatings and structural composites. It offers integrated solutions combining material innovation, manufacturing precision, and technical services tailored to stringent military standards. Its products provide enhanced survivability for defense equipment through multi-spectrum stealth and multifunctional protective properties. The company’s close collaboration with top academic and research institutions and its integration into national defense industrial chains further differentiate it as a trusted, innovative core supplier.
